_readme: First search for Riverside City College's term-by-term maps (S344, SkyWaypoint). The census found no sequence source (none_found), and the procedure record (v1, 2026-10-08) asks for the college's own map page before calling it absent. Web search (2026-10-08) found Educational Programs (/pathways/) and Instructional Pathways, and an Academic Senate packet (2026-05-04) saying RCC became a Pathways Program Mapper college in fall 2025 with its 2.0 maps being launched publicly. This read takes both pages' links to any map or mapper host.

questions.map_source: Where Riverside City publishes a program's term-by-term map, and whether it is a Program Mapper host.
